grades.quote: Instead, one needs to use a sequential style of I/O, where each read or write operation takes place not at a specified position, but wherever the last one left off.
grades.reason: Only partly relevant. It says pread/pwrite access a position within the file, while sequential read/write happens wherever the last operation left off. That touches the explicit-position versus implicit-offset distinction. It never mentions lseek, atomicity, or whether the file offset changes.
